output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 157 to 95 lines (39.5%) and from 10,777 to 6,665 characters (38.2%). It emphasizes boundaries, shared dependencies and transport transitions. Six peripherals hold configuration mechanics, dependency rules, concrete connections, evaluation callbacks, HTTP decisions and cleanup order. M = modular structure; C = calls; O = ownership/lifetime; D = data dependencies across those views.

The runtime critique is addressed by removing the central constructor inventory, giving detailed mechanisms a peripheral home, and aligning peripheral positions with their attachment rows. Evaluation now sits beside its evaluation anchor. Text rectangles do not overlap; all edge endpoints are valid and all diagrams are connected.

Evidence comes only from the supplied point definition and pinned source texts. bootstrap.ts establishes construction and sharing; vitePlugin.ts establishes transport and shutdown; the two routes.ts files establish dispatch; vite.config.ts establishes configuration; dependencies.test.ts establishes static constraints. In particular, bootstrap constructs one CanvasApiProjection and supplies it to both LiveCanvasService and AgentDiagrammingSessionService: sharing is established within this backend instance.

Seed refinements: the HTTP gate checks a falsy binding header, not merely header absence, and applies only to classified agent mutations. Shutdown registration requires an httpServer. Additional source-backed details include test exclusions, source-root defaults, named evaluation collections, definitions checking capability before reading the body, and DELETE /diagrams/publish falling through to diagrams.delete('publish') if admitted by the adapter. That last statement establishes dispatch, not deletion success. Cleanup has no local exception isolation; a synchronous disposer throw preventing later calls is an inference from the shown sequence.

Related-point labels use only relationship IDs supplied in context.json. The critique's suggestions to import context-status or receipt behavior from other canvases are not adopted: those implementations are outside the pinned evidence. Other points are neither recreated nor treated as sources. Imported mutation classification, handler internals, source classification and disposer implementations remain unverified. The binding-header exception establishes no authentication guarantee, and these call paths do not establish observed execution. Connector rendering remains unverified.

|   |   `-- Context library and diagram-context storage share the source resolver
|   |-- Workspace and diagram services receive the same primary store
|   |-- Selection receives the mapping runtime and agent source root
|   |-- Compaction combines core access with a runtime and injected prompt policy

|   |-- LiveCanvasService and AgentDiagrammingSessionService share

|   |-- Generation observation connects agent chat to evaluation reconciliation

|   |-- Replay, cancellation and lookups cross service boundaries via callbacks

|-- [C] Server attachment turns the captured graph into transports
|   |-- Plugin new-diagram-api exposes dev and preview hooks
|   |   `-- Both hooks use the same attach function and captured backend
|   |-- attach always installs the HTTP middleware
|   |-- An available httpServer also receives live-canvas sockets
|   `-- HTTP capability sets socket context-upload and canvas-write flags
|-- [C/M] HTTP entry selects a namespace before invoking application behavior
|   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next middleware
|   |-- Classified agent mutations pass through the HTTP capability gate
|   |-- Only /api/<known namespace> reaches a route factory's handler
|   |   `-- /internal enters the prefix filter but has no dispatched namespace
|   |-- Core project routes separate source queries from catalog operations
|   |   |-- Files, source and definitions use the source service
|   |   |-- Projections and compaction listings use the catalog
|   |   `-- Representation reads and compaction updates use CoreApplication
|   |-- Mapping routes expose workspace, diagram and workflow operations
|   |   |-- Optional service presence determines delegated handler availability
|   |   |-- Workspace reads/writes and record batches call workspace services
|   |   |-- Diagram save, checkpoint publication and deletion call diagrams
|   |   `-- Prompt preparation precedes streamed selection execution
|   |-- Explicit method checks return 405; unmatched routes return 404
|   `-- Imported handler internals are outside the pinned source
|-- [C/O] Response boundaries govern cancellation and error delivery
|   |-- Definitions requests attach cancellation to premature response close
|   |   `-- The route removes its listener when the awaited operation finishes
|   |-- Selection emits progress and result events after committing headers
|   |-- Awaited namespace failures are translated by the Vite adapter
|   |   |-- Before headers: typed failures become JSON status responses
|   |   `-- After headers: errors become stream events
|   `-- These are visible call paths, not evidence of observed execution

    |-- backend.dispose() calls service and runtime disposers in explicit order
    |-- Language-service cleanup is conditional on its construction
    |-- Cleanup registration itself requires an httpServer

    `-- Imported disposer implementations determine their internal cleanup

Dependency rules enforced by static tests [M]
|-- Allowed internal dependency targets
|   |-- domain -> domain
|   |-- application -> application + domain
|   |-- infrastructure -> infrastructure + application + domain
|   |-- server -> server + application + domain

|   `-- UI src -> src + domain + packages
|-- Ownership condition is independent of layer permission
|   |-- Composition origin bypasses only the ownership condition
|   `-- Otherwise: non-composition target AND (core OR same owner)
|-- External restrictions depend on the originating layer
|   |-- domain forbids node:, React/ReactDOM and Vite; UI forbids node:
|   `-- application forbids selected node: APIs and integration packages
|-- Dependency scan: TS/TSX; skip *.test.ts and *.test.tsx

HTTP decisions and request lifetimes [C/O]
|-- Mutation gate returns 403 HTTP_WRITES_DISABLED only when all hold
|   |-- httpEnabled !== true
|   |-- x-canvas-chat-binding header is falsy
|   `-- isAgentMutationRequest(method, pathname) returns true
|-- Optional mapping dependencies gate delegation
|   |-- evals/ requires evalRuns + evalPrompts + evalReferences
|   |-- generated-canvases requires evalRuns
|   |-- Other optional groups require their corresponding service
|   |-- integrations handler receives NEW_DIAGRAM_PUSH_TOKEN
|   `-- Missing dependency skips branch; unmatched request reaches 404
|-- Definitions: ensureDefinitionsEnabled BEFORE readBody
|   |-- Then create AbortController and response.once('close', abort)
|   |-- Abort only if !response.writableEnded
|   |-- definitions(body, signal); send result only if !response.destroyed
|   `-- finally removes the close listener
|-- Workspace write/export/import bodies: 64 * 1024 * 1024 byte limit
|-- Read defaults: records and representations use history=current, else all
|-- Prompt: selection.prepare completes before headers are committed
|   |-- Flush status 200, NDJSON and no-cache/no-transform headers
|   `-- selection.run -> progress events -> result event -> end()
|-- /diagrams/publish is method-sensitive
|   |-- POST -> diagrams.publishCheckpoint
|   `-- DELETE -> generic diagram route calls diagrams.delete('publish')
`-- Exceptions from awaited namespace handler
    |-- headersSent -> send error event
    |   `-- End only if neither destroyed nor writableEnded
    `-- Otherwise JSON error status
        |-- RequestTooLarge 413; ProjectDiagramConflict 409
        |-- Application conflict 409; binary-source 415
        |-- lsp-disabled / ai-disabled / storage-unavailable 503
        |   `-- Only LSP/AI disabled add LSP_DISABLED / AI_DISABLED code
        `-- invalid-input or other thrown error 400

Shutdown calls and their limits [O/C]
|-- attach registers httpServer?.once('close', callback)
|   `-- callback: disposeSockets?.() then backend.dispose()
|-- Backend disposer calls, in source order
|   |-- comparisonRuns -> evalRuns -> agentChat -> diffSessionWorkflows
|   |-- agent -> diagramEditRuntime -> canvasBridge
|   |-- languageService?.dispose()
|   `-- mappingRuntime -> chatRuntime -> compactionService
`-- Sequence has no await, try/finally or per-disposer catch here
    |-- A synchronous throw would prevent later calls in this sequence
    `-- Async completion and internal resource release are not established
